elements.name: form_instructions
elements.html:
This additional form helps the admissions committee determine how your previous studies meet the specific admission requirements for MSc Data Science and Artificial Intelligence.

Complete the form as follows:

  1. Applicant details – enter your personal information as it appears in your application.
  2. Previous studies – provide information about the degree(s) relevant to your application.
  3. Admission requirements – review the prerequisite subjects and topics.
  4. Relevant courses – add the passed courses from those degrees that you want to use as evidence for the admission prerequisites.
  5. Prerequisite coverage – indicate which of your relevant courses provide evidence for each prerequisite subject.

Complete all sections in English. Before you begin, have the official academic documents submitted with your application available. If an official English translation was submitted, use that version when completing this form.

After completing the form, generate and review the PDF report, then upload this PDF to OSIRIS.

pages.title: Prerequisite coverage
pages.description: For each prerequisite add applicable courses and select the topics they cover. If you have no relevant course for a prerequisite, continue to the next one. Each prerequisite can be supported by up to 3 relevant courses. A single course may be used as evidence for at most 3 prerequisites.
